AnyAllFilterLinkEntity.description: Contains filters on related tables without returning columns from those tables.

Conditions.description: Condition expressions that include attributes, condition operators, and attribute values.

FilterHint.description: Advanced Filter hints such as Union which can help with many or conditions on different tables.

Filters.description: A collection of condition and logical filter expressions that filter the results of the query.

IsQuickFindFilter.description: Indicates whether the expression is part of a quick find query.
